items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: I don't know who Edmund played with. I don't know.

ctx.x: I didn't listen to Edmund Hall when he was down here. Edmund? Yeah. I knew Edmund. Who was he with?
I don't know who Edmund played with. I don't know. I just remember now who Edmund played with. Did you hear anybody say?
No. I don't know too much except he was with Buddy. That's the one.
